fullPassage: We likely evolved color perception, in part, to better figure out whether or not food is good to eat. In ordinary sunlight, for example, a ripe tomato reflects a certain portion of the light and looks red and edible; a rotten tomato reflects the light differently and looks brown and disgusting. It is these light-reflecting properties (reflectance) of the tomato — its redness or brownness — that are important, not the fact that the tomato is illuminated by the sun; a red tomato under a blue lamp is just as edible. It so happens, however, that a red tomato absorbs blue light and does not reflect it. Consequently, a ripe tomato under a blue lamp does not look red but black, and rather unappetizing. This example illustrates the fundamental problem of color perception: it is impossible to separate a region's reflectance (color) from its illumination. Many animals take advantage of the confusion between color and illumination in their camouflage. These animals have darker backs than bellies (or the converse if they usually hang upside down, like some caterpillars). This countershading, whose traces can be seen in dogs, offsets the body-shape revealing effects of light and shadow, rendering the animal less visible from a distance.

det.tip: visible(보이는) ↔ hidden(숨겨진)

questions.passage: We likely evolved color perception, in part, to better figure out whether or not food is good to eat. In ordinary sunlight, for example, a ripe tomato reflects a certain portion of the light and looks red and edible; a rotten tomato reflects the light differently and looks brown and disgusting. It is these light-reflecting properties (reflectance) of the tomato — its redness or brownness — that are important, not the fact that the tomato is illuminated by the sun; a red tomato under a blue lamp is just as edible. It so happens, however, that a red tomato absorbs blue light and does not reflect it. Consequently, a ripe tomato under a blue lamp does not look red but black, and rather unappetizing. This example illustrates the fundamental problem of color perception: it is impossible to separate a region's reflectance (color) from its illumination. Many animals take advantage of the confusion between color and illumination in their camouflage. These animals have <u>darker</u> backs than bellies (or the converse if they usually hang upside down, like some caterpillars). This countershading, whose traces can be seen in dogs, offsets the body-shape revealing effects of light and shadow, rendering the animal less visible from a distance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 darker와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① heavier: 더 무거운 (의미축이 다름)
✅ ② lighter: 더 밝은, 더 연한 ←정답 (darker의 반대)
❌ ③ wider: 더 넓은 (관련 없음)
❌ ④ rougher: 더 거친 (관련 없음)
det.tip: darker backs(더 어두운 등) ↔ lighter(더 밝은)

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 light의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ 빛 — 가벼운 ←정답
❌ ① 가벼운 — 빛 (A·B 순서가 반대)
❌ ② 빛 — 빛 (B는 '가벼운'이지 '빛'이 아님)
❌ ④ 가벼운 — 가벼운 (A는 '빛'이지 '가벼운'이 아님)
det.tip: light: (A) 빛(명사, brightness) vs (B) 가벼운(형용사, not heavy)

det.korean: 동물의 색이나 형태가 주변 환경에 섞여 들어 눈에 잘 띄지 않게 하는 것 → camouflage(위장)
det.analysis:

questions.passage: In ordinary sunlight, a ripe tomato reflects a certain portion of the light and looks red and edible; a rotten tomato reflects the light __________ (different) and looks brown and disgusting.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 빛을 '다르게(differently)' 반사한다 — 동사 reflects를 수식하므로 부사가 필요하다.
det.analysis: reflects the light __________ (different)에서 동사 reflects를 수식하는 자리이므로 부사가 와야 함 → differently. different(형용사: 다른)를 differently(부사: 다르게)로 변환.
det.tip: different(형용사) → differently(부사: 다르게)

questions.passage: These animals have darker backs than bellies (or the converse if they usually hang upside down, like some caterpillars). This countershading offsets the body-shape __________ (reveal) effects of light and shadow, rendering the animal less visible from a distance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 체형을 '드러내는(revealing)' 효과 — 명사 effects를 앞에서 수식하며, 효과가 '드러내는' 능동 의미이므로 현재분사가 필요하다.
det.analysis: the body-shape __________ (reveal) effects에서 명사 effects를 수식하는 자리이며, 효과가 체형을 '드러내는' 능동 의미이므로 현재분사 → revealing. reveal(동사: 드러내다)을 revealing(현재분사)으로 변환.
